text: The flat modality ♭A in cohesive HoTT represents:
choices: the type A with all higher path structure collapsed
the 'discrete' or 'locally constant' version of A
explanation: ♭A is the 'underlying discrete type': it picks out the constant/locally-constant elements of A. In real-cohesive HoTT, ♭A corresponds to the set of locally constant maps into A.
